case_number: 2025 INSC 9; CIVIL APPEAL Nos………………..OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition(Civil) Nos. 34407-34408 of 2013)
summary: Land dispute over Khasra No.103; revenue record showed 'Johad (Pond)' in 1970; respondent claimed 'Oosar' land with alleged patta from 1981-82; authorities found patta fictitious due to inconsistent dates and missing allotment file; High Court reversed findings without evidence reappreciation; standard: High Court cannot reappreciate evidence under Article 226 unless findings are perverse or jurisdiction exceeded; concurrent findings of revenue authorities upheld; ex-parte civil decree based on earlier order set aside by High Court improperly.
legal_provisions_cited: U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 s.198(4)
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
Chandavarkar Sita Ratna Rao v. Ashalata S. Guram
Shamshad Ahmad v. Tilak Raj Bajaj
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; orders of Additional District Magistrate/Additional Collector and Additional Commissioner restored.
